comingLast.roast: in the clubhouse on 23, and yes, everyone knows where he is sitting
on 16 - his caddy (his mate with the beers) has gone quiet
escape number: 4. holes remaining: 3. belief in the clubhouse: modest.
the rescue mission: 2 points, 2 holes, no pressure at all
his round is over, his sweating is not - 1 above the line
in the clubhouse 2 above Crouch - cheering for him from a safe distance
finished 2 clear of the blue balls - now buying Crouch drinks out of gratitude
in the clubhouse 3 clear - his card is safe, his pride pending
safe by 3 unless the course gets generous late
